start.content: I have the means to secure the remains from the governor's staff, but it requires using up all my political leverage. Conscience is an expensive thing to buy back when you have kept silent for too long.

opposition.content: I did not speak during the vote. My voice was present but not raised. I waited for the outcome — and when the sentence was passed, I knew silence was complicity.

tomb.content: Joseph of Arimathea offered his own new tomb. A wealthy man's tomb, hewn from rock. That fulfilled Isaiah 53:9 — buried with the rich. I chose those linens myself — the finest cloth I could obtain quickly before the Sabbath began.

spices.content: Nicodemus brought seventy-five pounds of myrrh and aloes. That is Roman imperial weight, not Temple amounts. It was meant to honour the body properly. The women brought additional jars for the final anointing after Sabbath.

closing.content: And now the linens are there. The tomb is open. I walked inside this morning. I stood where I placed Him. And I find I am no longer grieving the way I expected to.
